# Duet Hearing

> Prevention-first audiology practice in Lake Forest, Illinois. Ear-to-brain evaluation and
> fitness, hearing aid fittings with real ear measurement, tinnitus care, ear wax removal,
> auditory processing, balance and vestibular assessment.

Site: https://duethearing.com

## Services

- [Ear-to-brain evaluation](https://duethearing.com/ear-to-brain-evaluation/)
- [Ear-to-brain fitness](https://duethearing.com/ear-to-brain-fitness/)
- [Hearing aid fittings](https://duethearing.com/hearing-aid-fittings/)
- [Real ear measurement](https://duethearing.com/real-ear-measurement/)
- [Ear wax removal](https://duethearing.com/ear-wax-removal/)
- [Hearing protection](https://duethearing.com/hearing-protection/)

## Conditions

- [Hearing loss](https://duethearing.com/hearing-loss/)
- [Tinnitus](https://duethearing.com/tinnitus/)
- [Auditory processing disorder](https://duethearing.com/auditory-processing-disorder/)
- [Ménière's disease](https://duethearing.com/menieres-disease/)
- [Sound sensitivity](https://duethearing.com/sound-sensitivity/)
- [Concussion and auditory function](https://duethearing.com/concussion-auditory-function/)
- [Balance and vestibular disorders](https://duethearing.com/balance-vestibular-disorders/)
